header:
# Town of Ferrisburgh municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists five elected Selectboard members: Chris Campbell (Chair), Walter E. Reed II (Vice Chair), Rick Ebel (Clerk), James Benoit, and Liz Markowski.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): confirms the Ferrisburgh roster, including Liz Markowski; the pre-meeting chair, Clark Hinsdale, rotated off at the February 28, 2026 town meeting and is not seated.
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists Kyle Rowe as elected Town Moderator.
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists three elected Listers: Brian Goodyear (Chair), Roderick Cole, and Tim Davis.
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists three elected Auditors: Andrew Dombek, Eric McEntee, and Jarad Roach.

Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists Jessy James Amblo as elected First Constable; no second constable appears anywhere in the town's list, so no Second Constable post is created.
Ferrisburgh town charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 119 (2017 No. M-13): section 3 provides that the Town Clerk is appointed by the Selectboard.
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists Jessica James as appointed Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Jessica James as Ferrisburgh Town Clerk (January 2026).
Ferrisburgh town charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 119 (2017 No. M-13): section 3 provides that the Town Treasurer is appointed by the Selectboard.
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): lists Lydia Sabourin as appointed Town Treasurer.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lydia Sabourin as Ferrisburgh Town Treasurer (January 2026).
Town of Ferrisburgh, '2026 Elected & Appointed Officials' list (ferrisburghvt.org): places the Collector of Delinquent Taxes under Appointed Officials: Tom Steadman.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Ferrisburgh justices of the peace: Joseph Baker, Robert North, Judy Chaves, Chris Kayhart, Art Cohn, Chris McClain, Jon-Taylor Vincent, Jean Richardson, Lissa Gebo, and Silas Towler. The town's officials list concurs (printing 'Judith Chaves'); the listing form governs the JP record.
